enemies.name: Marrow Lantern
enemies.notes: A hanging rib lantern, harmless until lit by cracked Crono's light (Crono at hairline or galaxy); the brain stays passive until then. It erases itself when Broken, teaching what NULL does. Projects a memory fossil of Marle at the vapour site. Break: harvest its light for the Crown puzzle.

enemies.name: Washi-Hollow Monk
enemies.notes: An inside-out monk. A non-weak hit flips it to show a blank back with a gold asanoha mark; only a hit on that mark counts (shaves) until it flips back. Break: unfolds into a prayer sheet showing a hidden fold line (a traversal Fold opens). Summoned in pairs by Kirie Keepers, where the pair shares a 10-plate shield.

enemies.name: Vertebray
enemies.notes: A stag of seven vertebrae, each skull from a different universe. Charges through the void with only a gold-dust telegraph (the wind-up telegraph is faint). At 50% HP it sheds two Fawns once (key vertebray_fawn: Shield 6 each, same tags); split_on_half must fire only once. Break: drops a bone bridge.

enemies.name: Vertebray Fawn
enemies.notes: Shed by a Vertebray at 50% HP (two at once). Not a codex row of its own: Shield 6 and the same tags as the stag, per E72. Gives no separate drop.

enemies.name: Ink-Eater
enemies.notes: [NULL] nullifies shave. A flat black smudge that breaks the 70% white rule and spreads in floor(TIME x 24)/24 steps. Unchecked for 12 s it inflicts BLIND 60% (Ink Blot) on the party. Moving through gold kirie clears its spread.

enemies.name: Kirie Keeper
enemies.notes: Mini-boss, x3 across U7. Shield 14 x 2 = 28: two stacked 14-plate shields, each its own Break (encoded as refill_once); plates regenerate 18%/s after 3 s without a shave. Summons two Washi-Hollow Monks (once, at the start) that share a 10-plate shield; the Keeper's own plates cannot be shaved until the monks' shared plate Breaks (not expressible as break_condition, which only gates the Break). Drops 13 Kirie Scales and a Gold Bundle (-10% Erosion). Spare = Light; kill = a Prismatic Shard.
